# umami_team_member (Resource)

A user's membership of an Umami team. The authenticated user needs the team-owner or team-manager role in the team, and must outrank the member's role to change or remove it. The team owner's own membership cannot be managed. Users themselves are created by an Umami admin. See [documentation](https://docs.umami.is/docs/api/teams) for more details.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "umami_team" "client" {
  name = "Example Client"
}

# Users are created by an Umami admin; reference them by ID.
variable "client_viewer_user_ids" {
  type    = set(string)
  default = []
}

resource "umami_team_member" "developer" {
  team_id = umami_team.client.id
  user_id = "8c3e2f1a-5b6d-4e7f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b"
  role    = "team-manager"
}

resource "umami_team_member" "client_viewer" {
  for_each = var.client_viewer_user_ids

  team_id = umami_team.client.id
  user_id = each.value
  role    = "team-view-only"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `role` (String) Role of the user in the team: `team-manager` (manage the team, its members and websites), `team-member` (manage websites) or `team-view-only` (view analytics only).
- `team_id` (String) ID of the team.
- `user_id` (String) ID of the user to add to the team.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp the user joined the team (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) ID of the membership, in the form `team_id/user_id`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import with the team ID and user ID, separated by a slash.
terraform import umami_team_member.developer 5e1ba5a1-263f-4edc-ba3a-988342134d17/8c3e2f1a-5b6d-4e7f-9a0b-1c2d3e4f5a6b
```
